scripts.name: Create Toposolid from model lines
scripts.summary: Samples selected model curves and creates a point-based Toposolid from their XYZ elevations.

selection.description: Three or more non-collinear XYZ points sampled from selected ModelCurve elements.

inputs.name: sampling_step_mm
inputs.description: Approximate sampling interval along each selected curve, in millimetres.

inputs.name: xy_tolerance_mm
inputs.description: XY tolerance used to merge duplicate sampled points, in millimetres.

inputs.name: toposolid_type_name
inputs.description: Exact Toposolid type name. The first type alphabetically is used when omitted.

inputs.name: level_name
inputs.description: Exact level name. The active view level or nearest level is used when omitted.

output.description: Created element ID and a summary of the sampled geometry, type, level, and Z range.

scripts.name: Calculate selected lines length in millimetres
scripts.summary: Calculates the total length of selected curve elements and prints millimetres.

selection.description: One or more CurveElement instances. Non-curve elements are ignored.

output.description: Total selected curve length in millimetres.

scripts.name: Calculate element volume
scripts.summary: Calculates solid volumes for selected family instances and prints cubic metres.

selection.description: One or more FamilyInstance elements with valid solid geometry.

output.description: A list containing cubic-metre volumes or per-element error messages.

scripts.name: Delete BIMO preview rays
scripts.summary: Deletes DirectShape elements whose ApplicationId is BIMO_PreviewRays.

selection.description: No selection is required; all matching DirectShape elements in the active document are deleted.

output.description: Number of deleted DirectShape elements, or a message when no match exists.
